locationNote: Historical panorama from this mission’s exploration region; the marker denotes the landing site. It is not a live view or an exact current rover location.
title: Opportunity Surroundings on 3,000th Sol
description: This 3D 360-degree panorama assembled from images taken by the navigation camera on NASA Mars Exporation Rover Opportunity. The Sol 3000 site is near the northern tip of the Cape York segment of the western rim of Endeavour Crater.
